text:
nina: Kicking off a product-level roadmap thread for model-catalog lifecycle (onboard -> pin -> deprecate -> migrate). Need concrete launch criteria and negotiation points for customers.
leo: Good. Let's align on milestones + a minimal acceptance checklist per model family.
frank: From infra side we want: runtime benchmark, quantization compatibility, and a smoke test for KV cache behavior.
amy: Product-side asks: customer opt-in flows, pin TTL policy, comm cadence, and migration credits.
nina: Proposal outline: 1) Onboard GA gates 2) Version pin policy 3) Deprecation runway 4) Migration incentives.
leo: For GA gates, suggest three buckets: safety/quality, perf/cost, infra/compat. Each must pass.
frank: Suggested measurable gates:
- quality: eval-harness pass-rate >= 95% vs control on canonical probes
- perf: median latency <= baseline + 12% and p95 <= baseline + 25%
- cost: per-token cost delta <= +20%
- infra: zero regresion in KV-cache-mismatch rate in shadow < 0.1%
amy: Customer-facing constraints: default soft-pin = 60 days auto-notify 14 days before expiry; hard-pin = annual contract only. Customers can request a 90d one-off extension.
nina: Deprecation runway: 90 days public notice + individual tenant outreach for pinned customers; emergency deprecation needs Exec + Legal signoff.
leo: Migration lanes plan (staged): shadow -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Each stage has a 2-hour stabilization window and an automated health check.
frank: Health check components: control vs candidate diff on eval probes, increase in error rates, p95 latency move, and a quick token-reconciliation smoke.
amy: Incentives: sliding migration credit: 2% credit for mild regressions (1-2%), 5% for 2-4%, and dedicated remediation for >4%. Also priority support queue for migrators.
nina: Decision rubric for pin exceptions: business impact score + security/compliance need + contract value. Anything over threshold requires Legal sign-off.
leo: Ownership: Product owns customer comm and acceptance criteria; Infra owns rollout automation and rollback; Solutions owns tenant probes.
frank: Preflight checklist snippet (for playbook):
```
- verify model artifact checksum
- run infra smoke (kv-cache, batching, kv-ttl)
- run eval-harness on canonical probes (prod-sim)
- check cost/latency projection
- confirm tenant probe mapping
- stage canary config in feature flag
```
amy: Communications plan: three touchpoints - PRE (72h email), LAUNCH (status channel + in-console banner), POST (summary + migration credit notice if applicable). Templates to be drafted by Solutions & Comms.
nina: Rollback quick command for SRE:
```sh
redwoodctl rollout revert --model catalog:ceres:v3 --to catalog:ceres:v2 --reason "health-check fail"
# also trigger: redwoodctl billing pause --scope rollout_id
```
frank: Note: we need to ensure the billing pause does not lose accounting; keep a reconciliation job.
leo: Roadmap timing ask: we want model-catalog lifecycle GA by next quarter. That's tight; need clear prioritization (critical: rollout automation, monitoring, pin UI).
amy: Negotiation levers to trade in sales conversations: extended pin TTLs, migration credits, and co-funded benchmarking. Track as part of product SOW template.
migrations-bot: migration-bot: new migration ticket M-2026-042 created for family ceres; assignee: frank.
nina: Action items: frank -> final infra checklist & rollback scripts by Wed; leo -> canary automation PO/PRD by Thu; amy -> comm templates + pin-TTL policy draft by Fri. I'll stitch into a single playbook doc and surface to PM review next Tue.
leo: I'll add a lightweight dashboard spec for the 1%/10% ramps.
amy: Also adding a FAQ for customers about "why we route to variant X" and how to request a pin.
nina: Great. If anyone has alternative thresholds or SLA/credit suggestions drop them here. :sparkles:
